title: HTP25
description: AccuPac® HTP25 (High Thermal Performance) Splash Fill is an injection-molded fill used in both counterflow and crossflow towers that produces heat transfer via droplet generation.

paragraphs: AccuPac® HTP25 (High Thermal Performance) Splash Fill is an injection-molded fill used in both counterflow and crossflow towers that produces heat transfer via droplet generation. The highly engineered drip design provides maximum thermal performance in a compact module. HTP25’s open, offset-flute, fouling-resistant design is ideal for applications where the circulating water has very high levels of suspended solids.
